Volume - 160 | BENGALURU, TUESDAY, 29, APRIL, 2025(VAISHAKHA, 09, SHAKAVARSHA, 1947) Issue 82

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA

RC-CFS0ADMN/139/2024-RC Karnataka Government Secretariat
E- 1297625 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru-560 001,
Date:03.08.2024.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RC-CFS0ADMN/139/2024-RC
E- 1297625 Dated 29/01/2024 regarding altering the limits of Nelludi Village of
Kampli Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
HOSA NELLUDI, SHANKAR SINGH CAMP, NELLUDI KOTTAL was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated 02/02/2024 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within
thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 09/02/2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said

Nelludi Village of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue village
called as HOSA NELLUDI Village of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No : RC-CFS0ADMN/113/2024-
RC.Dated 19-01-2024 regarding altering the limits of B.BELAGALLU Village of
BALLARI Taluk and BALLARI district and constituting a new revenue village
called B.BELAGALLU THANDA was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette Dated 21-02-2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner BALLARI district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 23-02-2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
B.BELAGALLU Village of BALLARI Taluk and BALLARI district to form a new
revenue village called as B.BELAGALLU THANDA Village of BALLARI Taluk
and BALLARI district along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No; RC-CFS0ADMN/154/2024-RC,E-
1299193 Dated:30/01/2024 regarding altering the limits of Kanakapura village of
Sandur Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
Nagenahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated: 02/02/2024
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 27/04/2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Kanakapura village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as Nagenahalli village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RC-CFS0ADMN/253/2024-RC,
E-1326134Dated 19/02/2024 regarding altering the limits of Tonasegeri village of
Sandur Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
Yaradammanahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated:
27/02/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 27/04/2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Tonasegeri village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue village
called as Yaradammanahalli village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/252/2024-RC,
E-1326019 Dated 20/02/2024 regarding altering the limits of SOVENAHALLI
Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village
called SANNA UPPARAHALLI was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette Dated :05/03/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 07/03/2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
SOVENAHALLI Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as SANNA UPPARAHALLI Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RC-CFS0ADMN/131/2024-RC,
E-1297302 Dated: 29/01/2024 regarding altering the limits of M.GUNDLAHALLI
Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village
called G.BASAPURA was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated
07/02/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 29/05/2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
M.GUNDLAHALLI Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District to form a new
revenue village called as G.BASAPURA Village of Sandur Taluk and Ballari District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RC-CFSOADMN/169/2024-RC
E-1301911 Dated 03/02/2024 regarding altering the limits of Mannur suguru
Village of Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue
village called Doddaraja Camp was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette Dated 26/02/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 29.02.2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Mannur suguru Village of Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari District to form a new
revenue village called as Doddaraja Camp Village of Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFSOADMN/233/2024-RC
E-1319244 Dated 13/02/2024 regarding altering the limits of Darur Village of
Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
Darur Camp was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated :26/02/2024
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 29/02/2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Darur Village of Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as Darur Camp Village of Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

E- 1212952 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru 560-001,
Date:15.04.2025

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 73 PFH 2023 Dated:06.11.2023
regarding altering the limits of Ryavanoor village of Jewargi Taluk and Kalaburgi
District and constituting a new revenue sub village called as Kasulal Nagar sub
village was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette dated:30.12.2023
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburgi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 16.04.2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of called Kasulal Nagar village of Jewargi
Taluk and Kalaburgi District convert the same to form hamlet/part within the
boundary of Ryavanoor revenue village and same will here in after be named as
Kasulal Nagar of Ryavanoor village in Jewargi Taluk and Kalaburgi District.

here by makes the following notification, namely:-

Date:15-04-2025

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Kemmale Village of Kanakapura
Taluk of Ramanagara District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Dombaradoddi-2 as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Kemmale village for conversion of Dombaradoddi-2 unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Ramanagara District.

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared ashabitation area of Dombaradoddi-2 village of Kanakapura
Taluk of Ramanagara District convert the same to form hamlet within the boundary
of Kemmale Revenue village and same will herein after be named as called
Dombaradoddi-2 of Kemmale village in Kanakapura Taluk of Ramanagara
District.
